Construct and revise the supplied room for its original design request using the fixed asset catalog. Preserve existing object identities and immutability constraints; use catalog asset_id for native additions. Inspect the current state, latest real receipts and five views. A successful edit does not establish collision freedom or activity suitability. Report unverified requirements as unknown.

[{"description": "See all furniture currently in the room with precise spatial data.

Shows existing furniture with positions, rotations, and bounding boxes.
Each object includes:
- dimensions: Width, depth, height in meters (object's local frame)
- world_bounds: Min/max corners showing exact space occupied in world

Use this to check clearances, understand scale, and plan placements.", "name": "get_current_scene_state", "parameters": {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {}, "required": [], "title": "get_current_scene_state_args", "type": "object"}}, {"description": "Place furniture in the room at a specific floor position.

Furniture sits flat on the floor at z=0 with upright orientation.
You can only control the x, y position and yaw rotation (rotation
around the vertical axis).

Each placement gets a unique ID so you can move or remove it later.
The same furniture model can be placed multiple times.

Use 'list_available_assets' to see what furniture you can place.", "name": "add_furniture_to_scene_tool", "parameters": {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"asset_id": {"description": "ID of the furniture to place.", "title": "Asset Id", "type": "string"}, "x": {"description": "X position in the room (meters).", "title": "X", "type": "number"}, "y": {"description": "Y position in the room (meters).", "title": "Y", "type": "number"}, "yaw": {"default": 0.0, "description": "Yaw rotation in degrees around vertical axis (default: 0.0).
Positive values rotate counterclockwise in top-down view.", "title": "Yaw", "type": "number"}}, "required": ["asset_id", "x", "y", "yaw"], "title": "add_furniture_to_scene_tool_args", "type": "object"}}, {"description": "Move existing furniture to a new floor position.

Furniture sits flat on the floor at z=0 with upright orientation.
You can only control the x, y position and yaw rotation (rotation
around the vertical axis).

Use this to relocate furniture that's already in the room. You need
the object ID from when you placed it or from 'get_current_scene_state'.", "name": "move_furniture_tool", "parameters": {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"object_id": {"description": "ID of the furniture item to move.", "title": "Object Id", "type": "string"}, "x": {"description": "New X position in the room (meters).", "title": "X", "type": "number"}, "y": {"description": "New Y position in the room (meters).", "title": "Y", "type": "number"}, "yaw": {"default": 0.0, "description": "New yaw rotation in degrees around vertical axis (default: 0.0).
Positive values rotate counterclockwise in top-down view.", "title": "Yaw", "type": "number"}}, "required": ["object_id", "x", "y", "yaw"], "title": "move_furniture_tool_args", "type": "object"}}, {"description": "Remove furniture from the room.

Use this to delete furniture you no longer want. You need the object ID
from when you placed it or from 'get_current_scene_state'.", "name": "remove_furniture_tool", "parameters": {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"object_id": {"description": "ID of the furniture item to remove.", "title": "Object Id", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["object_id"], "title": "remove_furniture_tool_args", "type": "object"}}, {"description": "Verify furniture orientation relationships and get exact rotation angles.

IMPORTANT: Use this tool to check facing relationships - it's MORE
RELIABLE than visual assessment. Always verify orientation-critical
furniture with this tool after placement or rotation.

Checks whether object A is correctly oriented relative to object B,
and provides the exact rotation needed for perfect alignment.", "name": "check_facing_tool", "parameters": {"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"direction": {"default": "toward", "description": "Direction to check. Valid values:
- "toward": Check if object A faces toward object B (default).
  Use for: chairs→tables, sofas→TVs, seating→focal points.
- "away": Check if object A faces away from object B.
  Use for: furniture against walls (drawers, shelves, washing
  machines, desks with backs to walls).", "title": "Direction", "type": "string"}, "object_a_id": {"description": "ID of the first object (the one being checked).", "title": "Object A Id", "type": "string"}, "object_b_id": {"description": "ID of the second object (the target).", "title": "Object B Id", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["object_a_id", "object_b_id", "direction"], "title": "check_facing_tool_args", "type": "object"}}]
